During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''naval officer''' was assigned to a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] patrolling the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]]. During a routine inspection of a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', the naval officer accepted a bribe from the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]].<ref name="RPG" />
